label: alpha Cen AB golden astrometric state for joint validation (Akeson 2021 J2019.5 barycenter observables, kinematic-frame RV; clearly labeled fixture, NOT a new measurement)

astrometry.rv_convention: kinematic frame (true line-of-sight velocity of the barycenter): spectroscopic gamma V0 = -22.3796 km/s (Akeson 2021) plus the +61.4 m/s gravitational-redshift zero-point correction of Kervella, Thevenin & Lovis 2017

uncertainties.labels: parallax and PM sigmas are Akeson 2021 catalog formal errors; rv sigma is the quadrature of the catalog 0.0020 and the 0.0027 frame-correction error; the 0.10 km/s working RV sigma used in dispersion studies is an adopted absolute-accuracy allowance, not a catalog sigma

sources.position_parallax_pm: Akeson et al. 2021, AJ 162, 14 (barycenter solution, native epoch J2019.5)
sources.rv: Akeson et al. 2021, AJ 162, 14, V0 = -22.3796 +/- 0.0020 km/s; kinematic correction +61.4 +/- 2.7 m/s from Kervella, Thevenin & Lovis 2017, A&A 598, L7

conventions.note: year_s is the Julian year; kms_per_masyr_pc = 4.74047/1000 km/s per (mas/yr pc); the propagation clock T runs from the state epoch J2019.5; departure-origin times subtract (departure_epoch_jyear - state_epoch_jyear) = 9.5 yr

model: linear kinematics: constant space velocity, r(T) = r0 + v T with T in years since J2019.5; T_cross = -z0/v_z; v_inf(T) = |r0 + v T|/T; beta(T) = asin(z(T)/|r(T)|); also reported: T_cross_from_departure_yr = T_cross_yr - 9.5 and crossing_date_AD = 2019.5 + T_cross_yr
